result.reason: The operative language reaches the playbook position: it covers Affiliates and contractors acting on Company’s behalf, makes the royalty-free perpetual licence irrevocable, and permits transfer to an M&A successor, satisfying at least the fallback transfer position. It preserves the licence’s original business-purpose limitation and corrects the defective derivative-works wording. However, adding “worldwide” is not required by the playbook, so the redline is not strictly minimal. Drafting quality is also reduced by the awkward dangling transfer phrase and the imprecise formulation “a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets,” which should identify Company and the relevant assets or business.
